name_en: Vidiyal Payanam (free bus travel for women)
department: Transport Department, Government of Tamil Nadu (State Transport Undertakings)
benefit: Women can ride government ordinary town buses (white board buses) for free. No ticket money is needed.

other: Transgender persons can also travel free.
A person who helps someone with 40% or more disability can also travel free.

where_to_apply: Ordinary fare town buses (white board) of all State Transport Undertakings in Tamil Nadu

evidence.quote: All women are allowed to travel free of charge in ordinary buses under the “Vidiyal Payanam” scheme with effect from 08.05.2021.
